response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web software developer with strong TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang skills, but has no demonstrated experience in SoC/IP modeling, hardware architecture, GPU/accelerator performance analysis, or deep-learning workload optimization — the core requirements of this Principal Performance Architect role. While he meets the years-of-experience bar and shows some systems-level aptitude (low-latency DLang services, embedded exposure), the domain gap between web/application development and hardware performance architecture is too large for a principal-level hardware-focused position.
strengths: 15+ years of software engineering experience, exceeding the BS + 8 years requirement
Some low-level/performance experience (low-latency DLang services with async I/O, fibers, caching; C/C++ at National Instruments)
Strong engineering craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, open-source contributions, and community teaching
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling, computer architecture, or hardware-software co-design experience
No GPU, SIMD/MIMD, or AI accelerator background; AI exposure limited to agent tooling (MCP), not DNN training/inference optimization
Career trajectory is web/full-stack product development, misaligned with a principal-level hardware performance architecture role

key_factors.factor: No AI accelerator or DNN workload optimization experience
General seniority and systems-level performance work
